title: NC-PLUS-FM-sweeper-red: Add sweeper freshness watchdog: cron-alarm re-run + alert if last ok pass is stale
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-FM-sweeper-red was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-FM-sweeper-red

Add sweeper freshness watchdog: cron-alarm re-run + alert if last ok pass is stale

Backlog done check: selfaudit:sweeper-staleness returns green when sweeper last ok pass is under 2 hours old and alarm re-fires on stale runs

Triage: Requires new Worker cron trigger and selfaudit probe logic plus alerting — beyond the doer's DB-only capabilities. | first step: Open a code task to add a scheduled cron handler that checks last-ok-sweeper timestamp in D1 and emits selfaudit:sweeper-staleness.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
